sentences: B: What kinds of movies do you like?
G: I like sci-fi movies.
B: Me, too.
Can you recommend a good sci-fi movie for me?
G: Try Travel to the Future.
It’s really good.
A: Can you recommend a restaurant for me?
B: How about Morning in Venice?
A: What kind of food do they have?
B: They have Italian food.
I strongly recommend their cheese pizza.
It’s really good.
A: Dr. Schofield, I hear you have a Korean name.
Can you tell me about it?
B: It’s Seok Hopil.
I love it because it sounds similar to my English name.
Also, it has a good meaning.
A: I’d like to know why you helped the Korean independence movement.
B: Well, I believe every country has the right to be independent.
A: What did you do after you returned to Korea in 1958?
B: I worked hard to help Koreans, especially poor students.

items.statement_ko: B는 G에게 어떤 종류의 영화를 좋아하는지 물었다.
items.why_ko: B가 What kinds of movies do you like?라고 물었다.
_evidence_text: B: What kinds of movies do you like?
items.statement_en: B asked G which type of movies she enjoys.

items.statement_ko: G는 공포 영화를 좋아한다고 답했다.
items.why_ko: G는 공상과학(sci-fi) 영화를 좋아한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: G: I like sci-fi movies.
items.statement_en: G answered that she likes horror movies.

items.statement_ko: B도 같은 종류의 영화를 좋아한다고 말했다.
items.why_ko: B가 Me, too.라고 답했다.
_evidence_text: B: Me, too.
items.statement_en: B said that he likes the same kind of movies.

items.statement_ko: B는 G에게 좋은 공상과학 영화를 추천해 달라고 부탁했다.
items.why_ko: Can you recommend a good sci-fi movie for me?라고 부탁했다.
_evidence_text: Can you recommend a good sci-fi movie for me?
items.statement_en: B asked G to suggest a good sci-fi movie to him.

items.statement_ko: G가 추천한 영화 제목은 Travel to the Future이다.
items.why_ko: G가 Try Travel to the Future.라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: G: Try Travel to the Future.
items.statement_en: The movie G suggested is called Travel to the Future.

items.statement_ko: G는 그 영화가 그저 그렇다고 평가했다.
items.why_ko: G는 It's really good.이라며 아주 좋다고 했다.
_evidence_text: It’s really good.
items.statement_en: G said the movie was just so-so.

items.statement_ko: A는 B에게 식당을 추천해 달라고 부탁했다.
items.why_ko: A가 Can you recommend a restaurant for me?라고 물었다.
_evidence_text: A: Can you recommend a restaurant for me?
items.statement_en: A asked B to recommend a place to eat.

items.statement_ko: Morning in Venice라는 식당을 제안한 사람은 A이다.
items.why_ko: How about Morning in Venice?라고 제안한 사람은 B이다.
_evidence_text: B: How about Morning in Venice?
items.statement_en: A is the one who suggested the restaurant Morning in Venice.

items.statement_ko: A는 그 식당에 어떤 종류의 음식이 있는지 물었다.
items.why_ko: A가 What kind of food do they have?라고 물었다.
_evidence_text: A: What kind of food do they have?
items.statement_en: A asked what kind of food the restaurant serves.

items.statement_ko: 그 식당은 프랑스 음식을 판다.
items.why_ko: 이탈리아 음식(Italian food)을 판다고 했다.
_evidence_text: B: They have Italian food.
items.statement_en: The restaurant sells French food.

items.statement_ko: B는 그곳의 치즈 피자를 강력히 추천했다.
items.why_ko: I strongly recommend their cheese pizza.라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: I strongly recommend their cheese pizza.
items.statement_en: B said the cheese pizza there is really worth trying.

items.statement_ko: B는 그 음식이 정말 맛있다고 덧붙였다.
items.why_ko: It's really good.이라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: It’s really good.
items.statement_en: B added that the food is really good.

items.statement_ko: A는 Schofield 박사에게 한국 이름이 있다는 이야기를 들었다.
items.why_ko: I hear you have a Korean name.이라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: A: Dr. Schofield, I hear you have a Korean name.
items.statement_en: A heard that Dr. Schofield has a Korean name.

items.statement_ko: A는 그 한국 이름에 대해 이야기해 달라고 요청했다.
items.why_ko: Can you tell me about it?이라고 부탁했다.
_evidence_text: Can you tell me about it?
items.statement_en: A asked him to talk about that Korean name.

items.statement_ko: Schofield 박사의 한국 이름은 석호열이다.
items.why_ko: 한국 이름은 Seok Hopil(석호필)이다.
_evidence_text: B: It’s Seok Hopil.
items.statement_en: Dr. Schofield's Korean name is Seok Hoyeol.

items.statement_ko: 그는 아버지가 지어 준 이름이라서 그 이름을 좋아한다.
items.why_ko: 자신의 영어 이름과 발음이 비슷해서 좋아한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: I love it because it sounds similar to my English name.
items.statement_en: He loves the name because his father gave it to him.

items.statement_ko: 그는 그 이름에 좋은 뜻도 담겨 있다고 말했다.
items.why_ko: Also, it has a good meaning.이라고 했다.
_evidence_text: Also, it has a good meaning.
items.statement_en: He said the name also carries a good meaning.

items.statement_ko: A는 그가 한국 독립운동을 도운 '방법'을 알고 싶다고 말했다.
items.why_ko: 방법이 아니라 도운 '이유(why)'를 알고 싶다고 했다.
_evidence_text: A: I’d like to know why you helped the Korean independence movement.
items.statement_en: A said he wanted to know how he helped the Korean independence movement.

items.statement_ko: 그는 모든 나라가 독립할 권리를 가진다고 믿는다고 답했다.
items.why_ko: every country has the right to be independent라고 말했다.
_evidence_text: B: Well, I believe every country has the right to be independent.
items.statement_en: He answered that he believes every country has the right to be independent.

items.statement_ko: 그는 1968년에 한국으로 돌아왔다.
items.why_ko: 1958년에 한국으로 돌아왔다고 했다.
_evidence_text: A: What did you do after you returned to Korea in 1958?
items.statement_en: He came back to Korea in 1968.

items.statement_ko: 한국에 돌아온 뒤 그는 특히 부유한 사업가들을 도왔다.
items.why_ko: 특히 가난한 학생들(poor students)을 돕기 위해 열심히 일했다.
_evidence_text: B: I worked hard to help Koreans, especially poor students.
items.statement_en: After returning to Korea, he especially helped rich businessmen.
